session_selection.rationale: Selected the workspace-local Codex root 01a03768-0f28-7781-b309-8273bce2a530: it begins with benchmark implementation and owns 59 named subagent threads spanning mesh, solver, report, results, and completion audits. Excluded no independent root candidates. Database cwd is the Docker path /workspace; all telemetry was rebased only within this workspace .sessions bundle.

points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable cb2bac0 clean CMake build passed in cfd-bench with network disabled, 2 CPUs/3GiB/256 pids and documented roots; no production CFD rerun.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: Required solve CLI, validation, and explicit bad-input paths are implemented. Restart stores one state level plus time/step; transient_driver.cpp:105–108 rebuilds history and takes backward Euler on resumed first step.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: cb2bac0 src separates case/config, mesh, physics, numerics, MPI, drivers and I/O; 2D geometry is a deliberate limit.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No external solver invocation or copied core found in reviewed implementation; no exhaustive external similarity search.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp:57–103 parses case/input options; mesh and scheme selected from configuration rather than benchmark filenames.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:285–325 creates global mesh on root and releases it before distributed solve; partitioner uses METIS and halo_exchange.cpp:59–70 exchanges neighbors. Selected rank studies do not show order-one force changes.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: main.cpp:52–103 checks arguments, cgns_reader rejects unsupported elements, residual.cpp positivity fallback and steady_driver checks nonphysical states. Transient production telemetry and binary version remain qualified.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Independent clean build ran all eight bounded verification tests successfully: uniform state, both conservation orders, gradient, Jacobian, spectral radius, Riemann and reconstruction. Tests used supplied NACA cases; no Re200 rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Report and source are curated reproducibly; archived binary-provenance documentation explicitly distinguishes older Re200 build. Report has a fallback-count inconsistency documented separately.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: core/types.hpp and physics/perfect_gas.cpp implement 2D conservative perfect-gas equations; report.tex describes nondimensional equations.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: cgns_reader.cpp supports TRI/QUAD/MIXED and multiple zones with interface welding; production Re200 log reports both zones and 10185 merged cells. No 3D support.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: numerics/residual.cpp constructs interior and boundary FV fluxes, with positivity fallback. Eight bounded verification checks passed including first- and second-order conservation; these do not prove full-run convergence.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: numerics/riemann.cpp:94–166 implements Roe/Harten-Yee with Rusanov fallback; HLLC and Rusanov alternatives exist. Re200 exact old binary remains unbound.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: numerics/boundary_conditions.cpp and residual.cpp:264–311 implement farfield, slip and adiabatic no-slip wall paths; wall output semantics use boundary values.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: residual.cpp:115–190 reconstructs limited face states; seven steady metadata entries revision b350651 report active second order with documented fallback. Re200 full-run fallback count was not measured on older binary.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Venkat and positivity guard exist in source. Steady M2 selected metadata reports 595 fallback events on 324 steps; contestant docs/binary_provenance.md:117–120 says 326, a stale/inconsistent count. Re200 production fallback counts were not measured; a separate one-rank first-100-step probe cannot establish the remaining trajectory.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: numerics/viscous.cpp implements stress/heat transport and solver/forces.cpp:122–131 projects wall traction tangentially; reported pressure/viscous split is not a full normal traction mislabel.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: solver/implicit_lusgs.cpp contains implicit spectral-radius LU-SGS sweeps; steady stopping checks residual and Cd window. Selected M015 laminar lift drift qualifies the Cd-only check.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Final transient source assembles total BDF residual and measures inner ratio (transient_driver.cpp:185–209,246–264,288–294); selected Re200 metadata claims 0/30000 misses, log provides sampled ratios and t300. Exact older production binary is not independently bound; no unsteady rerun.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: main.cpp:285–325 root preprocesses/partitions and destroys global mesh; halo_exchange.cpp:59–70 performs neighbor nonblocking exchanges. Submitted np1/np8 comparisons lack order-one absolute force mismatch.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: All eight selected production packages are present, and restart_io.cpp saves actual state/time/step; transient restart reconstructs missing prior BDF level and resumes with backward Euler.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Snapshot records explicit examiner checks. Independently ran clean build and 8 bounded NACA/unit tests; these structural/method checks do not replace Re200 production validation.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Seven selected steady runs have b350651 metadata; M2 inviscid reports 2.55-order force plateau and M015 laminar lift drifts in last400. Re200 reaches t300 with reported target counts but exact production binary remains unbound.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 selected Cd2.018 and Re200 raw Cd1.216–1.259/Cl±0.513 over t>=100 are plausible with moderate coarse-mesh limitations; St reported0.182, FFT diagnostic0.17999.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted 52-page report contains readable steady histories, fields and Re200 wake/force figure; startup spike compresses late Re200 drag so the explicit late lift/drag criterion is unmet.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: The report gives extensive case tables, fields, limitations and plateau discussion. report.tex:372–380 states both positivity events are counted per step, but Re200 production binary lacked fallback telemetry; docs/binary_provenance.md qualifies the gap. Its stated M2 fallback count 326 differs from selected metadata 595.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Reports/figures have manifest links. Steady cases report revision b350651, whereas Re200 revision is null and contestant binary_provenance.md says pre-15:05 build at a628093 or earlier; the separate 100-step single-rank fallback probe does not cover full 4-rank transient.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Immutable cb2bac0 clean CMake build passed independently in cfd-bench, as did eight bounded verification checks. CLI and required output paths are source-backed; no production MPI rerun. restart_io.cpp:60–75,127–135 stores one state level with time/step; transient_driver.cpp:105–108 reinitializes second history and takes backward Euler after restart, so exact multistep continuation is limited.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: cgns_reader.cpp handles TRI/QUAD/MIXED and multizone welding; Re200 log documents both cylinder zones and 10185 cells. Geometry is 2D.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: residual.cpp assembles inviscid and viscous face residuals with farfield/slip/no-slip treatment; bounded conservation tests passed at both orders. Production Re200 binary provenance remains qualified.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Final source implements LSQ/Venkat reconstruction and positivity fallback. Seven steady selected metadata revision b350651 reports production activation; Re200 old binary lacks full-run fallback telemetry, with a submitted separate first-100-step one-rank probe only.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: viscous.cpp supplies Newtonian/Fourier gradients and forces.cpp:122–131 tangential traction; physically plausible steady force splits are reported.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: CFL/LU-SGS and true BDF2 two-loop Re200 implementation; scalar approximation limits fidelity. Restart restores one state level and restarts with backward Euler before BDF2, rather than preserving the previous BDF history; no production restart rerun performed.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: main.cpp:285–325 releases root global mesh before solve, METIS and neighbor halos are source-backed; selected np1/np8 NACA and Re20 forces show no order-one absolute difference. No independent MPI production rerun.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Seven steady b350651 cases have plausible fields/forces, M2 inviscid a documented 2.55-order plateau, and M015 laminar lift drifts late. Re200 raw shows lift/drag oscillation and St≈0.18 but its delivered late-drag plot fails the distinct post-processing floor.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: The accepted 52-page report gives extensive case tables and figures, but its only Re200 force figure compresses late drag under the startup spike, so the required late lift/drag behavior is not both readable. Binary provenance/telemetry qualifications are documented.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Case-driven physics/BC modules and solver abstractions support extension; mesh and conserved state remain explicitly 2D.

flags.evidence: No external solver executable call found in reviewed CMake/source.

No direct evidence force/residual histories were generated without solving; source has true residual/force writers and selected files and logs, but historical transient binary attribution is not exact.
Case/config drives mesh path; generic cgns_reader handles multizone and mixed cell types, not only two filename branches.
Source contains implicit LU-SGS and BDF2 dual-time paths; selected metadata/logs report physical t300, subject to old binary qualification.
Roe/Harten-Yee, Venkat reconstruction, viscous stress and BDF components are present in source. Tangential force split is implemented; no missing claimed algorithm established.

M2 inviscid selected data has a documented bounded Cd plateau at 2.55 orders; M015 laminar small absolute lift drift qualifies but does not alone prove failed success. Re200 reports zero target misses and sampled log ratios, but exact old binary and full fallback telemetry are unresolved.
Plot script maps split triangles to source cells explicitly; no specific figure shown to depict unrelated field/CSV. Not every figure was regenerated independently.
METIS partition and local/ghost solution are implemented, with root global mesh destroyed before iterations; no full-state replication or geometric-only masquerade established.

Seven steady metadata entries report b350651 production reconstruction; source contains active LSQ/Venkat. Re200 older binary exact attribution and full-run fallback count unresolved, but no proof disabled production reconstruction.
Surface writer and boundary paths use no-slip wall state; selected validator wall checks are recorded. No proof adjacent-cell velocity was mislabeled as no-slip wall.
Plot script maps named Mach and pressure fields and uses triangle-to-cell mapping; no specific misnamed figure established.
No direct copied/wrapped CFD core found; no exhaustive external similarity search.

limitations: No evaluator clean-build or MPI rerun was performed; documented reproduction and rank evidence were inspected only.
NACA M2 inviscid stopped at a certified 2.55-order residual plateau rather than its nominal target.
Re200 wake resolution is limited: reported St=0.1824 and mean Cd=1.2359 are modestly low and the report discloses this.
The solver and geometry abstractions are 2-D.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.

All ten rubric sections, eight cases, 27 review points and 13 numbered DQ rules were reviewed to available evidence. Exact Re200 producing executable and complete-run fallback counts remain unbound. No CFD/Re200 rerun.
